planets.name: Kepler-736 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-736 with a 3.6-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: Kepler-736 b crosses its star every 3.6 days and is 2.9 times as wide as Earth, found in 2016.
text.introduction: Kepler-736 b transits Kepler-736 every 3.6 days and is 2.9 times as wide as Earth. Orbit and size follow Morton et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
